name: Nagai Kouji
source:
A mutual friend who used to hang out with Ryosuke and Asami. He is now Asami's husband. 

He is a good man, though thoughtless, but that is how he ended up taking on his friend's debts. 

He runs around every day trying to raise money, and lately he has become very tired. 

[From [url=https://www.ubai.org/ubai/ubai/ubai_chara.html]official site[/url]]
